# Belgium, Flanders — 2018

> Benchmark chips for Belgium-Flanders cut from the 2018 edition of the harmonized field boundary collection be_vlg.

- [Collection](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/be_vlg_2018/collection.json)
- [README](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/be_vlg_2018/README.md)
- [Agent guide](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/be_vlg_2018/AGENTS.md)
- [Field boundary lines](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/be_vlg_2018/be_vlg_2018_boundary_lines.parquet)
- [Chip definitions with field coverage](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/be_vlg_2018/be_vlg_2018_chips.parquet)
- [Chips (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/be_vlg_2018/chips.pmtiles)
- [Field boundary polygons](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/be_vlg_2018/be_vlg_2018_fields.parquet)
- [Field polygons after the class filter](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/be_vlg_2018/be_vlg_2018_fields_filtered.parquet)
- [Field boundaries (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/be_vlg_2018/fields.pmtiles)
- [STAC items in GeoParquet format (collection mirror)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/be_vlg_2018/items.parquet)
